description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesList' that displays a list of notes with search, pagination, and delete functionalities. It interacts with external API services to fetch and delete notes, manages local state for UI interactions, and renders a user interface for note management.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API based on current page, page size, and search parameters, updating the component state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a note by ID, confirms with the user, calls API to delete, and refreshes the notes list.
